title: Ruthless Bar Salts Frozen Exotic Mango On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Frozen Exotic Mango on Ice delivers a luscious blend of ripe, tropical Mango with a crisp menthol finish. The sun-kissed sweetness of Mango brings a smooth and juicy flavour, balanced by a delicate tang that keeps each puff refreshing. A wave of cooling menthol enhances the exhale, leaving a clean and frosty finish that makes this an ideal choice for fruit and menthol lovers alike. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a smooth and consistent vape with satisfying vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation provides a comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption for a flavour-packed all-day vape. Ruthless has established itself as a leader in bold and high-quality e-liquid formulations, offering expertly crafted blends that continue to set industry standards. Their nic salt range brings these signature flavours into a format designed for modern vaping needs.
